title: Does what it is supposed to do.
text: Does what it is supposed to do.. The Fanhaq shoe rack is a little tiresome to assemble, but once it is, it serves its purpose. (Oddly enough, it even comes with white gloves to protect your hands from some black stuff that comes off the parts.) It is my opinion that it holds shoes without heels better than those with heels (this isn’t a deal breaker for me, but ladies beware). This is perfect for the garage where we keep shoes that we don’t use every day. Now my garage appears to be more organized. It will equally work in a closet or dorm room, really anywhere that it is needed. It is a decent quality, affordable and useful.
